name: Get Landing Page Content
summary: Lists the page's content sections (forms, images, text, snippets) in order.
whenToUse: When you want to see what is on a landing page and where each piece sits.

path.name: id
path.label: Landing Page ID
path.hint: Find it via List Landing Pages.

response.description: Content sections in layout order: type (Form, Image, RichText, Snippet, …), index, and content.

notes: A section must appear in this list before it can be updated via the content-update endpoints.
